note: Versioned index of the cross-language conformance kit. The fixtures under conformance/ and the two JSON Schemas beside this file are the shared wire contract; Rust (tests/conformance_manifest.rs), Python (crates/sharpearena-py/tests/test_wire_conformance.py) and npm (npm/sharpearena/test/conformance.test.js) each read this same file by repository path. None of the three depends on either of the others as a package, so checking the same kit everywhere adds no dependency edge in any direction. The kit_version below moves when the fixture set changes; contract_version is the wire version the kit certifies and follows GOVERNANCE.md, not the package versions.
